messages:
emma: Starting ramp window for release v2.3.1. Change window 01:00-02:00 UTC. Initial exposure 5% -> target 25% over ~30m. Please ack and monitor latency, errors, and quality.
chris: Ack. Dashboards up (infra/rollout). Watching p50/p95/p99 and pod restarts.
maya: Note: this build includes the new quantized kernel. If we see quality regressions we can pin to model@2026-03-01-hash.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: Initiated staged rollout release=v2.3.1 percent=5% region=us-east change_window=2026-03-20T01:00Z operator=emma
raj: Release notes: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RELEASE-231 — includes batching tweak, KV-cache warmup, quantization toggle.
chris: Minor blip: p95 up ~2% in eu-west on synthetic traffic. Not critical yet but noted.
emma: Hold at 5% for 10m to validate. Can we gate the next lift until signoff? @sre-oncall please standby.
sre-oncall: Oncall ack. I'll run health checks and watch error budget. If error rate >= 2x baseline I'll call rollback.
ops: Turned on canary verbose logging for the rollout to capture a sample of requests. Will rotate logs after warmup. :mag:
deploy-bot: Deploybot: Scheduled next lift -> 15% at +10m (manual confirmation required)
maya: If we observe formatting drift, plan is: 1) enable response-normalizer fallback, 2) pin to model@2026-02-15, 3) rollback if quality still degraded.
chris: Alert: seeing OOMs on 3 containers in us-east-1 (same instance family). Investigating stack traces.
emma: Stop the ramp. @deploy-bot cancel-scheduled-lift. Pin current rollout at 0% for v2.3.1 until we triage. Prep rollback plan.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: Cancelling scheduled lift. Initiating rollback workflow: scale-down v2.3.1 replicas -> drain connections -> promote routing back to v2.3.0. Notifying services.
raj: Noted. I will update PMs + Comms and mark the changelog as aborted for this window.
chris: Root cause likely quantized kernel mismatch on a1.large family. Workaround: revert quantization flag on runtime; patch under investigation.
emma: Decision: full rollback to v2.3.0 for production. Postmortem owner: chris. Action items: 1) hotfix quantization flag, 2) add canary stress tests for kernel combos, 3) update release checklist. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
